meta.name: Ishq in the Air
meta.description:
A chance encounter collides the fates of Naman and Kavya on a flight propelling them on an unforeseen journey of love. But as time unfolds, will they surpass the turbulent complexities of their contrasting worlds and backgrounds to embrace the love that’s in the air?

Rated U/A 16+ · Returning Series · First aired 20 Sept 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: BBC Studios India · Network: Amazon MX Player

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Connecting
videos.overview: At Indore airport, Naman, struggling with his first flight, meets Kavya and is captivated by her allure. After a misunderstanding, Kavya helps an introverted Naman sparking a connection. Their delayed flight helps them get to know about each other’s contrasting lives. As their bond deepens, Kavya appreciates his humility while Naman wishes this journey never ends.

videos.title: Following
videos.overview: Naman and Kavya's time exploring Sarafa Bazaar leaves them with happy memories. Despite their chemistry, reality pulls them apart. Naman, unable to get Kavya out of his mind and inspired by her words, plans a grand gesture.

videos.title: Free Fall
videos.overview: Seeing Kavya's world, Naman is filled with hope for a possibility of a new way of life. A new opportunity can propel him onto a new path if he's willing to take the chance. But choosing one over the other isn't going to be so easy.

videos.title: Excess Baggage
videos.overview: Tensions rise at Naman's house, as he feels conflicted between his loyalty to them and a future he desires. Kavya wants to find out whether what she's feeling for Naman is a fleeting attraction or something real.

videos.title: Last and Final Call
videos.overview: Kavya and Naman are forced to talk about their relationship and where they stand, making them wonder whether they are too different to make this work.
